tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind everything.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Sidebar, header bars, the main content panel.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, the composer, the command menu.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row or nav item; pressed ghost button.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between regions, card outlines, list dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3:1 against bg-elevated).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on any bg-* surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, placeholders' labels.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, counts, keyboard hints. Never body copy; on a selected row use text-muted instead.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, focus ring, selected indicator, live wave. A lighter (dark theme) and deeper (light theme) step of the logo green.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and success text on bg-* surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted fill: success badges, drop zones, focus halo.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, failed steps, error text.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Error banner and failed badge fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-attention text and icons (needs sign-in, paused).

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning badge fill.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The wordmark next to the mark (follows text colour).

tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: The logo green: the ring-and-wave mark only. Never text on light.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the command menu and mobile drawer.

families.sans: "Geist Variable", Geist, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono Variable", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the empty-chat greeting.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Chat messages from the agent and the user.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, inputs, buttons, list rows.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, nav labels when selected, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Descriptions and metadata under a row title.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Section labels in the sidebar, badges, keyboard hints. The floor: nothing smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and rows; gap between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of rows and nav items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (small), gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections; top padding of pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, keyboard hints, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, the command menu.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, the send button.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on empty states; composer send button area.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of chat and page content.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Command menu, menus, the mobile drawer.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: The chat composer only.
